title: Micro800 - Analog Values Randomly Read Min or Max and Stay Stuck
technician_version: Micro850 PLC with a 2080-IF4 analog plug-in module, 2 channels used. Values read correctly for a while, then randomly jump to max or 0 on both channels at the same time and stay stuck until the PLC is power cycled. Online during the event the raw values are maxed/zeroed, but mA measured at the module looks normal. No PLC faults. Already swapped the 2080-IF4 for a new one; same problem. Should I move to a 2085-IF4 expansion module, or is this a PLC hardware or program issue?
fault_symptom: Both analog plug-in channels intermittently latch at max or 0 until power cycle; field mA normal; no controller fault; module replacement did not fix
notes: Frozen OP-only via curl HTML extract; 2 replies exist, not read. Answer not researched; no MIRA/FactoryLM calls. MrPLC RSS had no new topic since 45945. Runner-ups: PLCTalk Moxa NPort 5410 serial (vague), 1769-L30ER Studio 5000 V26 upload.
